finalText:
All tests pass. Fix verified.

Cause: `processOrder` wasn't guarding the release with try-finally. On validation errors, connections leaked. Around 2am, bad order data triggered repeated failures → all 5 connections exhausted → cascading timeouts and restarts.

Solution: Wrap in try-finally to guarantee release, matching the `withConnection` pattern already in the codebase. Connections now return to pool even when processing fails.
